description: Source file for Python tracer integration in PyTorch JIT, including functions for callstack retrieval, graph creation via tracing, and Python bindings setup.

classes.name: TracingState
classes.description: Class representing the state during tracing, including graph management and scope control.

methods.name: _create_graph_by_tracing
methods.description: Creates a computation graph by tracing a Python function with given inputs and options.

methods.name: _get_value_trace
methods.description: Gets the trace value associated with a variable.

methods.name: _set_value_trace
methods.description: Associates a trace value with a variable.

methods.name: _tracer_warn_use_python
methods.description: Sets a warning function for Python tracer usage.

methods.name: _tracer_set_get_unique_name_fn
methods.description: Sets a custom function to get unique variable names during tracing.

methods.name: _tracer_set_force_outplace
methods.description: Configures whether to force out-of-place operations during tracing.
